Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 142. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 25 Ki per Disk
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Destructo Disk
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 120 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Barrage
A barrage of frisbee like attacks that can cut through
almost anything.
Roll an Omni Attack Roll dealing 4d12 slashing
damage each on a hit. This damage deals double
damage to structures and constructs.
You may fire an amount of Destructo Disks equal to
your proficiency bonus.
